errors.evidence: The legend is located on the middle-right side of the chart, not in the top right corner.
The values for the total area (blue bars) are consistently at or above 60,000 hectares, never dropping to 59,000. The peak in 2018 is slightly above 61,000.
The chart is a grouped bar chart. For each year on the x-axis, there is a group of two bars (one blue, one orange). The description incorrectly states they are not grouped.
